technique_name: Describe a situation when a machine can be more successful than a human.
description: A machine can be more successful than a human in situations where precision and accuracy is required. Machines are able to process data faster and more accurately than humans, and can often complete complex tasks more quickly. Machines can also be programmed to complete certain tasks more efficiently than a human can, such as recognizing patterns in large data sets or recognizing an object within an image or video. Machines can be better than humans when it comes to difficult and repetitive task
